validators.checks: solid bodies that overlap each other instead of touching
parts that are not carried, directly or transitively, by the ground along the declared gravity axis
shelf sag under the declared design load against the span and absolute deflection limits
free-standing bodies that tip below the minimum safe tilt angle
tall shallow furniture that must be anchored to the wall
hole edge material, hole spacing, hinge cup envelopes, drawer-slide pair alignment and minimum panel thickness
furniture that leaves the declared room volume
walking passages narrower or lower than the declared minimum
declared static loads against the supports that actually carry them

collision_scope: Native conservative envelopes; coverage and issue caps retained verbatim. Not an exact collision certificate.
presentation: Base color only: Blender scene-linear RGB converted to rounded 8-bit sRGB. Glass remains opaque; alpha, transmission, metallic and roughness are not applied. No textures, lights, shadows, reflections, cameras, Filmic/view transform or exposure are transferred; this is not Blender render parity.

color_transfer.limits: Base color only: Blender scene-linear RGB converted to rounded 8-bit sRGB. Glass remains opaque; alpha, transmission, metallic and roughness are not applied. No textures, lights, shadows, reflections, cameras, Filmic/view transform or exposure are transferred; this is not Blender render parity.
color_transfer.extraction: AST literal material assignments; no material/presentation execution.
color_transfer.mapping: Original trusted exact evidence names/IDs/materials, bound to source SHA256.
